QuestInfo.name: [8th Anniversary] Rolling 8's
QuestInfo.0: There's a fun new game taking place just for Maple World's 8th birthday. You should join in the fun!
QuestInfo.1: If you can get your hands on some 8th Anniversary Dice, you can roll yourself into a delightful new game!
QuestInfo.2: The Maple Admin will give you a pair of 8th Anniversary Dice every 10 minutes. Click on the dice icon on the left side of the screen, or double-click the dice in the Set-up tab to join in on the game right away!
